About Me
I have experience in e-commerce, social media marketing, marketing research, and data analytics.
Through the MSDM program, I am developing practical skills in R, SQL, survey research, digital analytics, and data visualization.

What I Do
Marketing Analytics: Analyze campaign and customer data to support marketing decisions.
Data Visualization: Create reports and dashboards using R, Quarto, and Looker Studio.
Customer Research: Design surveys and study customer behavior using Qualtrics.
Digital Marketing: Work with social media, content, e-commerce, and digital strategy.

title: Using CSS and SCSS
text:
CSS controls the visual appearance of a website, including its colors, fonts, spacing, and borders. SCSS provides additional features, such as variables and reusable styling rules.
For this website, I used a separate CSS file to keep the colors and formatting consistent across the different pages.
